name: excalivibe
description: Vibe Working capability suite — authored once under src/, compiled to Claude plugins, Codex plugins and the vendor-neutral .agents/ layout.

plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: How to operate a computer — the capabilities an agent needs to reach past its own text output and act on a real machine. Currently browser control with automatic framework selection and degradation, and rich human-readable document artifacts with a local preview.

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Atomic development skills — engineering conventions, working methods, and check-and-verdict passes. Each one stands alone, triggers on its own subject matter, and assumes nothing about who invoked it, so they compose freely rather than only inside a pipeline.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Development pipeline roles — the subagents that make up an orchestrated flow, each a single responsibility with its own inputs, outputs and boundaries. The orchestration engine that sequences them is still being designed, so the roles here carry no wiring to any particular one.
